LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.0.label: Bound Talisman
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.0.descript: Retains the talisman’s original damage block, recovery, defense and movement without duplicating base stats. Progression stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.1.label: Sheltering Stride
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.1.descript: An ordinary hit records your position. Move at least 3 cells and hit again within 3 seconds to shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The first hit only records position. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.2.label: Steady Resolve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.2.descript: Land three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, with at most 3 seconds between hits to heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Switching targets resets the count. Secondary damage does not count; permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.3.label: Returning Veil
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.3.descript: Under the same movement-and-hit condition as Sheltering Stride, also shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Works without an ally; the two shields resolve independently. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.4.label: Running Aid
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.4.descript: Under the same movement-and-hit condition as Sheltering Stride, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects independently from the shield and does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.5.label: Steadfast Seal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.5.descript: After Steady Resolve actually heals you, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Grants nothing at full health or without recoverable injuries. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.6.label: Renewed Counter
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Talisman.nodes.6.descript: After Steady Resolve actually heals you, store one charge of renewal for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy consumes it for 50 damage. One charge maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Healing at full health grants nothing. Base rewards: damage 50.
